nodes.title: The Smith's Debt
nodes.description: Baron Vrell's men drag Garrick the blacksmith into the square. He owes the Baron a fortune, and the Baron wants the monster hunter to settle it.

nodes.title: Execute the Smith
nodes.description: You accept the Baron's coin and execute Garrick in front of the crowd. The debt is settled in blood.

nodes.title: Pay Garrick's Debt
nodes.description: You empty your purse to clear Garrick's debt. The grateful smith promises to forge you anything.

nodes.title: Walk Away
nodes.description: Not your problem. You leave Garrick to haggle with the Baron's thugs himself.

nodes.title: The Rebel Courier
nodes.description: A courier from Ysolde's rebellion finds you at the inn: the Baron's keep can be stormed, but they need a hunter with a silver blade.

nodes.title: Recruit Lambert
nodes.description: Your old sparring partner Lambert is drinking away his wages. A little persuasion and he joins your cause.

nodes.title: Join the Rebellion
nodes.description: You swear to Ysolde's cause and learn the location of the keep's postern gate.

nodes.title: Sell Out the Rebels
nodes.description: You take the Baron's bounty and hand over the rebels' hideout. Ysolde's lieutenants hang at dawn.

nodes.title: Royal Armor
nodes.description: Only Garrick knows the old royal technique. He must forge the silver blade from the ore you recovered.

nodes.title: The Drowned Archive
nodes.description: A flooded library beneath the keep. The archive door only opens with the Archivist's key.

nodes.title: The Archivist's Vault
nodes.description: Inside the archive, the Archivist's skeleton still clutches the key to the archive itself.

nodes.title: Storm the Keep
nodes.description: Ysolde's rebels breach the postern gate while you cut through the Baron's guard with the silver blade.

nodes.title: Spare the Prisoners
nodes.description: You unlock the dungeon cells and let the Baron's prisoners walk free.

nodes.title: Burn the Dungeons
nodes.description: You torch the dungeons with everyone still inside. No witnesses.

nodes.title: The Victory Feast
nodes.description: The town celebrates the Baron's fall. Lambert raises a toast to your friendship, and the freed prisoners dance in the square.
nodes.narrative_requirements: Lambert is present as the player's companion; the prisoners from the dungeon are alive and free.

nodes.title: The Forgotten Shrine
nodes.description: A shrine to a forgotten goddess, cut from the main storyline during development.
